source.title: AI SDK
source.description: Entry point for the `ai` TypeScript package, covering `generateText` with swappable provider model strings, zod-schema `generateObject` and `streamObject` structured outputs, `tool` calling, and install commands.

source.title: Build a fullstack app with Next.js 16 and Prisma Postgres
source.description: Tutorial building a blog with Prisma schema, `prisma.config.ts`, and the `pg` adapter over Marketplace Postgres, Sign in with Vercel `OAuth` (PKCE, `jose`), Server Actions for drafts/publishing, and `vercel deploy`.

source.title: Agent Resources
source.description: Hub linking machine-readable docs (`llms-full.txt`, `.md` pages), the Vercel MCP server, AI Gateway coding agents, Skills.sh installs via `npx skills add`, and end-to-end CLI workflows.

source.title: Vercel Plugin for AI Coding Agents
source.description: `npx plugins add vercel/vercel-plugin` for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot; auto-injects session context only in Vercel/Next.js projects, plus 28 on-demand skills, 3 specialist agents, and 5 slash commands like `/vercel-plugin:deploy`.

source.title: Agent Skills
source.description: Official Vercel skills directory categorised by React/Next.js, AI SDK, design, browser automation, deployment, and commerce; install with `npx skills add <owner/repo>`, `eve` auto-detects into `agent/skills/`, browse skills.sh.

source.title: CLI Workflows
source.description: Directory of end-to-end CLI workflow guides linking debugging production errors, deployment rollback, rolling releases, custom domains, environment variables, feature flags, and Vercel Sandbox into complete work sessions.

source.title: Use Vercel's MCP server
source.description: Remote OAuth MCP server at `https://mcp.vercel.com` for searching docs, managing projects/deployments, and analyzing logs; `add-mcp` install across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot; confused-deputy protection and human-confirmation security practices.
